Blackstone’s real estate business is undergoing a leadership transition as declining earnings, weaker investment returns and senior executive departures create challenges for one of the world’s largest real estate investment managers, according to Bloomberg.

David Levine and Giovanni Cutaia have been named global co-heads of Blackstone Real Estate, succeeding Nadeem Meghji, who announced in September that he would leave the firm by year-end. Meghji became sole head of the business in January following the departure of former co-head Kathleen McCarthy.

Levine, who previously led Blackstone’s Americas real estate business, and Cutaia, formerly president of Blackstone Real Estate, will oversee the division as it works to deploy capital, improve investment performance and prepare for its next major fundraising cycle.

David Levine과 Giovanni Cutaia가 Blackstone Real Estate의 글로벌 공동 대표로 선임됐다. 올해 9월 연말까지 회사를 떠난다고 밝힌 Nadeem Meghji의 후임이다. Meghji는 공동 대표였던 Kathleen McCarthy가 떠난 뒤 1월부터 단독으로 사업을 이끌어 왔다.
이전에 Blackstone의 미주 부동산 사업을 이끌었던 Levine과 Blackstone Real Estate 사장을 지낸 Cutaia는 자본 투입(딜 집행)을 늘리고 투자 성과를 개선하며 차기 대규모 펀드레이징 사이클을 준비하는 가운데 부문을 총괄하게 된다.
